title: From What Is Used to What Is Missing: Rethinking Dynamic Rank in LoRA
abstract: arXiv:2611.07349v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning with LoRA is governed by rank, which controls parameter budget and locally accessible task updates. Existing dynamic-rank methods mainly focus on capacity allocation, leaving unresolved whether the current adaptation space is sufficient for the task. We characterize the first-order information boundary of standard factor gradients, showing that their unobservable subspace coincides with the normal space of the low-rank manifold. Thus, factor gradients alone cannot distinguish under-optimization within the current space from task-relevant directions beyond its first-order reach. This motivates a geometric view of rank evolution, where tangent information optimizes existing degrees of freedom and the normal spectrum quantifies the value of new ones. Under a local quadratic model, we show that leading normal singular directions yield the locally optimal rank expansion, with spectral energy determining its g

translated_title: 从“已用”到“缺失”：重新思考 LoRA 中的动态秩
translated_abstract: 基于 LoRA 的参数高效微调由秩主导，秩控制着参数预算以及局部可访问的任务更新。现有的动态秩方法主要关注容量分配，而未解决一个关键问题：当前的适应空间是否足以完成任务。我们刻画了标准因子梯度的一阶信息边界，证明其不可观测子空间恰好与低秩流形的法空间（normal space）重合。因此，仅凭因子梯度无法区分当前空间内的欠优化与超出其一阶可达范围的任务相关方向。这启发了一种理解秩演化的几何视角：切向信息用于优化现有的自由度，而法向谱则量化引入新自由度的价值。在局部二次模型下，我们证明主要的法向奇异方向能够给出局部最优的秩扩展，且谱能量决定了扩展的……
tldr: 该论文从几何视角重新思考 LoRA 的动态秩，揭示因子梯度的不可观测子空间与低秩流形法空间重合，并提出利用主要法向奇异方向及其谱能量来确定局部最优的秩扩展，从而判断当前适应空间是否满足任务需求。
en_tdlr: This paper rethinks dynamic rank in LoRA through a geometric lens, showing that the unobservable subspace of factor gradients coincides with the normal space of the low-rank manifold, and that leading normal singular directions with their spectral energy determine the locally optimal rank expansion to assess whether the current adaptation space suffices for the task.
